purpose: Prevent bank-selection corruption when generated S3 dispatch code routes expanded IR/event/value/call storage. S3 relational predicates and three-way compare have different result domains and must never be conflated.

boolean_relations.rule: A match over a boolean relation may use -1 as true and 0 as false. The +1 arm must be impossible/fail-closed; it must never be interpreted as greater-than or as a second false branch carrying distinct routing semantics.

three_way_compare.rule: Only an explicitly proven <=> comparison may use all three trit outcomes as ordered less/equal/greater routing.

safe_boolean_split.pivot_equality: match selector == pivot: -1 selects pivot; 0 continues partition; +1 is fail-closed
safe_boolean_split.partition: inside equality-false path, match selector < pivot: -1 selects left subtree; 0 selects right subtree; +1 is fail-closed
safe_boolean_split.leaf: match selector == leaf: -1 selects leaf; 0 and +1 fail closed
safe_boolean_split.invalid_selector: must fail closed rather than aliasing a valid bank

proof_obligations: every valid logical bank ID maps to exactly one physical bank
no two valid logical bank IDs alias the same routed case unless their payload is intentionally identical and the metadata contract explicitly allows aliasing
selectors at or above bank_count fail closed
boolean relation +1 arms are never used to encode ordered-greater routing
bank-count changes require rerunning exhaustive routing proof
generated S3 source must be type/semantic checked before native qualification
native qualification remains authoritative after static/exhaustive helper proof

known_regression_shape.description: A generated tree treats selector < pivot as if its match result were an ordered ternary relation. Because < returns only -1/0, a +1 branch is unreachable and distinct non-less subtrees can collapse/alias.
known_regression_shape.required_regression: tests must demonstrate that the unsafe three-way interpretation is rejected and that bank IDs 0..N-1 route one-to-one under the safe algorithm

integration_rule.preferred: capacity/event/value/call bank generators call one shared relation-safe dispatch helper instead of carrying private ad-hoc comparison trees
integration_rule.temporary_acceptance: an existing private helper may remain only if its generated routing is exhaustively proven against the same contract
